none: PAS CAM-D78CC6: Roman Coin : Incomplete Copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian. Mint is uncertain, AD364-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.43g, diameter is 17.93mm
